{{one source |date=April 2024}}
In mathematical [[set theory]], the '''Mostowski model''' is a [[Model theory|model]] of set theory with [[Atom (set theory)|atoms]] where the full [[axiom of choice]] fails, but every set can be [[Linear extension#Order-extension principle |linearly ordered]]. It was introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Mostowski|year=1939|authorlink=Andrzej Mostowski}}. The Mostowski model can be constructed as the [[permutation model]] corresponding to the [[automorphism group|group of all automorphisms]] of the ordered set of [[rational numbers]] and the ideal of finite subsets of the rational numbers.
